**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted |
| "has become Bristol's favourite tea" | **Unsupported.** This is a superlative with no survey or sales data behind it. The 4.8 rating is from reviews on your own website and doesn't show Bristol-wide preference. |
| "small team of six" | Fine. Team size is a product fact under the policy. |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted |
| "We buy from gardens we've visited." | Not on the allowlist, but it falls under sourcing and origins, so I haven't blocked it. Confirm it is true of every garden you buy from, because "gardens we've visited" implies all of them. |

**Fix:** Cut "has become Bristol's favourite tea". If you want a popularity line, use the allowlisted one: "rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website".

**Suggested version:**
Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. We buy from gardens we've visited.
